crossRefs.note: David arose, and passed over, he and the six hundred men who were with him, to Achish the son of Maoch, king of Gath.
Then Achish gave him Ziklag that day: therefore Ziklag belongs to the kings of Judah to this day.
After the death of Saul, when David had returned from the slaughter of the Amalekites, and David had stayed two days in…
when someone told me, ‘Behold, Saul is dead,’ thinking that he brought good news, I seized him and killed him in…
Ner became the father of Kish. Kish became the father of Saul. Saul became the father of Jonathan, Malchishua…
Ner became the father of Kish. Kish became the father of Saul. Saul became the father of Jonathan, Malchishua…
Now these are the chief of the mighty men whom David had, who showed themselves strong with him in his kingdom…
and said, “My God forbid me, that I should do this! Shall I drink the blood of these men who have put their lives in…
Benaiah the son of Jehoiada did these things, and had a name among the three mighty men.
Behold, he was more honorable than the thirty, but he didn’t attain to the three; and David set him over his guard.

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Kish
people.line: Father of Saul, the first king of Israel

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

people.name: Ziklag
people.line: A city given to David; originally Judah's, then Simeon's

translations.web: Now these are those who came to David to Ziklag, while he was a fugitive from Saul the son of Kish. They were among the mighty men, his helpers in war.
translations.bsb: Now these were the men who came to David at Ziklag, while he was still banished from the presence of Saul son of Kish (they were among the mighty men who helped him in battle;
translations.kjv: Now these are they that came to David to Ziklag, while he yet kept himself close because of Saul the son of Kish: and they were among the mighty men, helpers of the war.
translations.asv: Now these are they that came to David to Ziklag, while he yet kept himself close because of Saul the son of Kish; and they were among the mighty men, his helpers in war.
